INRAE has published a portrait of my research journey, **“Quentin Petitjean, entre écotoxicologie des abeilles et science ouverte”**, written by **Véronique Oiknine**.

The profile follows my work from contaminants in soils and freshwater ecosystems to my current research on wild bees at INRAE’s Bees & Environment unit in Avignon. It also explores my commitment to open science and reproducible research.

Published on **12 May 2026**, the article is available in **French**.

[Read the full portrait on INRAE’s website](https://www.inrae.fr/actualites/quentin-petitjean-entre-ecotoxicologie-abeilles-science-ouverte){.button-link}

For more about my background, visit [About & contact](../../about.qmd) or my [CV](../../cv.qmd).
